svg.title: Cooling plant CP-A02 dimensioned architecture plan
svg.desc: Original section-local architectural floorplan, service reserves, machinery and proposed reactor connector. Dimensions in metres. Not runtime validation.

g.text: CP-A02 · DIMENSIONED LOCAL PLAN + PORTAL SECTION · 08 SEP 2026
METRES | entry (0,0,0) | +Y into room | +Z up | proposed module, connection not applied
P01 / 5.00 W × 5.00 H / OVERHEAD DOOR FIXED OPEN
5.80m clear ceiling. Walls 0.30m thick. S03 design
targets; as-built acceptance pending. Floor is flush; no
raised platform. Section stays at local Y ≥ 0.
The 2.20m centre lane is permanent. The east 1.20m strip
is equipment reach space, and the rear withdrawal box is a
reserved work volume. Neither is a public cart route.
Reserve terminal and capped mine-water connection support
later emergency recovery. No external utility endpoints
Threshold in reactor: (8.4, −8.4, 0). Rotate local module
−135° about Z. Entry endpoints match the 5m P02 southeast
Whole-shell plan separation: Control ≥0.899m in Y; east
stair ≥7.499m in Y. Shared 0.36m reactor wall seam
requires connector coordination. New turbine-room fit
Source: interface.json / original vector geometry / dimensions govern / plan arithmetic ≠ Blender or runtime validation
